title: Fuego Down Hooded Jacket - Men's
description: Our iconic down jacket now features a 100% recycled DWR-finished shell and the same responsibly sourced 800-fill down you know and love. With an improved fit, this jacket is one you’ll never want to take it off. Fuego is the jacket we turn to year-round, from summer camping to winter wandering. A classic down jacket made from recycled fabric with year-round versatility. Packs into internal pocket.

title: Calidez Down Parka - Women's
description: Take on the elements in style this winter with the Calidez Down Parka. Its waterproof shell and fully sealed seams lock in warmth and blocks out weather. The windproof design adds extra protection, while the fleece-lined hand pockets provide cozy warmth. With a removable hood, this jacket combines functionality with versatility for all your adventures in town and beyond. An everyday puffer made with responsibly sourced materials.

title: Repleto Down Jacket - Men's
description: Wrap yourself up in the warmth of the Repleto Down Jacket while strolling colorful city blocks. This lightweight down jacket sheds light wind and snow, and the hand pockets are perfect for storing your phone, wallet, or gloves on gray fall days. A warm yet lightweight jacket for strolling through town. Packable.

title: Bacano Fleece Jacket - Men's
description: Unmatched style and cozy warmth? The high-pile Bacano Fleece Jacket checks both boxes with a higher neckline, super soft fleece, and retro-inspired patchwork. Plus, the zippered hand pockets and interior drop-in pocket keep your essentials secure, making this fleece the perfect choice for chilly days on the go. A high-pile fleece for strolling around town or cozying up in the cabin.

title: Tempa Fleece Hooded Jacket - Men's
description: Nordic ski, snowshoe, hike, and more in the Tempa Fleece Hooded Jacket. We designed the sleeves to allow freedom of movement, while flatlock seams prevent chafing. Keep your essentials close in the zippered hand pockets, and stay fresh during your most active moments with a Polygiene® anti-odor finish. Your new winter adventure companion, made with recycled materials.

title: Capa Hybrid Insulated Hooded Jacket - Women's
description: This jacket simplifies layering during brisk adventures. Its synthetic PrimaLoft® Gold P.U.R.E. (Produced Using Reduced Emissions) Insulation helps regulate your temperature, while stretch paneling in the sleeves and knit side panels make quick movements easy. Run, hike, and seek adventure in this movement-ready, hybrid layer. Packs inside its own interior chest pocket.

title: Rayu Rain Jacket - Women's
description: A tried and true rain shell built for slick city streets, the Rayu Rain Jacket has you covered around town. With two zippered hand pockets and a cinchable hood, this fully waterproof shell has all the features you need and none that you don’t.

title: Rayu Rain Parka - Women's
description: Stroll city streets with confidence in the Rayu Rain Parka. This extended length rain shell is built with recycled polyester and a breathable mesh lining—it’s a fully waterproof design that repels spring showers without missing a step.

title: Impermeo 3L Hooded Shell Jacket - Men's
description: Built for the unexpected, the Impermeo 3L Hooded Jacket is a burly shell for coastal hikes and summer thunderstorms alike. Fully seam-sealed, three-layer protection fights off the elements, while two-way stretch keeps you cruising along the trail. Built-in adjustability lets you dial the fit for maximum protection, and the whole thing packs into a pocket for easy storage when the sun pokes through. Afternoon storms are no match for our most technical trail shell.

title: Pacaya Lite Hooded Jacket - Men's
description: For spring wind and breezy summits, throw on the Pacaya Lite Hooded Jacket so you can fully enjoy the view. Built entirely from super lightweight recycled nylon, this breathes well on the way up, and offers protection when you need it. The internal sternum snap keeps the jacket on securely while unzipped to maximize airflow when you need to cool off on trail.

title: Teca Crop Jacket - Women's
description: This cropped jacket is a spin on our tried-and-true Teca Windbreaker that provides weather resistance without sacrificing mobility. Made with 100% repurposed polyester taffeta, the Teca Crop Jacket hits at the natural waistline for a relaxed yet flattering fit. A packable, weather-resistant, limited-edition layer, now in a cropped silhouette.

title: Sombra Sun Hoodie - Women's
description: A classic fit plus UPF 50+ sun protection makes the Sombra Sun Hoodie perfect for throwing over a tank top when high noon approaches. A sunny adventure staple with UPF 50+ protection.
